Monsoon Arrives in North India, Bringing Relief from Heat

The monsoon has arrived in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand, bringing much-needed relief from intense heat and humidity. Heavy rainfall has been reported in various districts, leading to a significant drop in temperatures. The arrival of the monsoon is expected to benefit farmers and has been a subject of widespread reporting across Hindi media.
